title: He He He Ha (Clash Royale)
blurb: Emoted at you immediately after a loss, by a player who spent the entire match placing a giant with three elixir left. The Clash Royale king's taunting laugh is the most punchable sound in mobile gaming and has long since escaped the game to become the internet's default troll laugh — four syllables, no words, maximum disrespect. Play it after winning anything at all, especially by luck, especially against somebody who cares more than you do. Supercell shipped a psychological weapon and charged nothing for it.
origin: The king's laugh emote from Clash Royale (Supercell), gaming's premier taunt.
